article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Wyatt Fricks scored 34 points and made seven 3-pointers as Marshall beat Elon 96-89 on Wednesday. Fricks also had nine rebounds, four assists and two blocks for the Thundering Herd (3-0). Noah Otshudi scored 14 points and added eight rebounds. Matt Van Komen had 14 points and shot 5 of 8 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line. Marshall went 15 of 32 from distance. Chandler Cuthrell led the way for the Phoenix (2-1) with 28 points despite going 0 of 8 from 3-point range. Randall Pettus II added 17 points for Elon. Bryson Cokley had 14 points. Marshall led 45-43 at halftime, with Fricks racking up 15 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
